items.answer:
The build is still going. It's in the study phase: it has opened notion.com, taken screenshots at phone, tablet and desktop sizes, opened its menus and pop-ups, and is now looking at how the page behaves. It hasn't written any of the Atlas interface yet, and no feature branch exists yet.

One thing to keep in mind: it opened notion.com in a private browser, which means it isn't logged in. So it's studying Notion's public homepage, not the inside of the app (the sidebar, pages and databases). If the inside of the app is what you want for Atlas, ask for that as a change. You could send screenshots of your own Notion workspace or describe the screens you want.
